question_text: Outline one difference between the movements of values in bubble sort and selection sort.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Bubble sort repeatedly compares and swaps neighbouring values. Selection sort finds the smallest remaining value and swaps it into the next sorted position.

marking_points.criterion: Selection locates a remaining minimum before placing it.
